mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 57 degrees at Verona City Hall with a waxing gibbous moon, an air quality index of 82, and the ISS passes overhead, though you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. The overnight low will be 52 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona is accepting feedback on several developments, including the Ardent Glen subdivision and site plans for Milky Way, which will be discussed on November 4th. Additionally, residents are reminded that tax bills will arrive by December 15th.
There is plenty to do in Verona, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run. Tomorrow, visit the Dane County Farmer's Market at the Capitol or enjoy the music series at Paddy Mac's.
On October 15th, the Verona Police Department responded to a report of dangerous driving and arrested a bus driver for operating while impaired, also known as O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The store is currently open but will be closing soon in 24 minutes, so be sure to stop by before they shut their doors for the night.
